target_customer: Independent financial advisors and RIAs who pay per seat for meeting notes, CRM and a client portal
problem: Advisors spend hours on meeting notes, CRM entry and client follow-up in legacy CRMs and billing tools.
product_category: AI meeting assistant and CRM for financial advisors

founders.name: Fernando San Martin
founders.background_notes: The YC page labels both founders CTO.

competitors.name: Jump
competitors.what: AI assistant that records advisor client meetings and produces notes, tasks and compliance records

technical_complexity.rationale: Transcription and summarization came from APIs, so the work was integrations with CRMs and custodians plus compliance features.

defensibility.rationale: Moving client records and billing into the product can lock in advisors, but notetaking alone was copyable and several rivals were funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Altruist, a custodian and advisor platform, acquired Thyme in June 2025 and planned to relaunch it as Hazel.

market_need_then: About 300 thousand US advisors rely on legacy CRMs per Thyme's own pitch. Funded rivals such as Jump in 2024 show investor and buyer interest in advisor notetaking.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as a makeover for the advisor's digital Rolodex

rebrands.why: Altruist said it would relaunch Thyme as a standalone platform called Hazel after the acquisition.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand coverage found. The name collides with Thyme Care, an oncology company, and was retired after the acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Thyme was a two person team building an advisor operating system in a category where Jump and others raised money in 2024. It was acquired by Altruist in June 2025, under a year after its batch, and renamed Hazel. The price is unknown, so the outcome reads as a distribution-minded acquisition of a small product and team.
notes: VCBacked and CB Insights both list about $500K total with Y Combinator and Altruist as investors, with a pre-seed dated 2024-09. These are aggregators only, so not recorded as rounds. CB Insights dates the acquisition 2025-06-12, which matches the Altruist post of 2025-06-20 within days. Zeplyn raised a seed in November 2024, after the batch, so it is left out of the as-founded list. Brand search found no source on the name.
